items.text: NVDA, AVGO’s AI Backstops Have One Analyst Worried — Michael Burry Says There’s A Reason Nvidia’s 5Y CDS Are Going ‘Parabolic’
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Burry指出Nvidia(NVDA)5年期CDS呈'抛物线'走势，暗示AI泡沫风险，并点名AVGO为同类风险标的。

items.author: Burry
items.text: Michael Burry Doubles Down On Palantir Bear Case: ‘A Lot Of’ Money Still To Be Made Shorting PLTR
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Michael Burry加倍下注看空Palantir(PLTR)，称仍有大量做空空间。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk, Jensen Huang and Tim Cook are set to dine with Xi this week. Here’s what their companies want from China.
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk与黄仁勋(NVDA)、库克本周将赴华与习近平会晤，议题涉Tesla、芯片、AI在华业务，宏观利好中美科技/AI板块。

items.author: Burry
items.text: QXO jumps after ‘Big Short’ investor Michael Burry reveals stake (QXO:NYSE)
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Burry披露建仓QXO，消息公布后QXO股价跳涨。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Did Elon Musk Just Drop a Big Hint About a Possible SpaceX-Tesla Merger?
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk暗示SpaceX与Tesla(TSLA)可能合并的传闻，SpaceX为未上市公司故不计ticker。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Morgan Stanley Maps Tesla-SpaceX Ties in ‘Physical AI’ After Musk Hint
items.summary_cn: 据报道，摩根士丹利在Musk暗示后发布报告，梳理Tesla(TSLA)与SpaceX在'物理AI'领域的协同效应。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Tesla reopens Roadster reservations – but you'll need $50K
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Tesla(TSLA)重新开放Roadster预订，需先付5万美元订金，反映高端车型需求信号。

items.author: Trump
items.text: We are just leaving the White House Lawn on the maiden voyage from the newly built, and very beautiful, Heliport! I want to thank Jim Taiclet, CEO of Lockheed Martin, who made this valuable contribution to our Country. Our Government has been thinking about doing this for 25 years, but was never able to get it done. I get things done! Also, and most importantly, THANK YOU to the Great Construction Workers and Stone Masons of the Washington, D.C., area, who created something very special, and to Clark Construction for its wonderful supervisory work. GOD BLESS AMERICA! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普感谢洛克希德·马丁(LMT)CEO Jim Taiclet为白宫新建直升机停机坪所做的贡献，含隐性背书。

items.author: Burry
items.text: Michael Burry Warns Hyperscalers Are Hiding $3 Trillion In AI Liabilities — And Wall Street Isn’t Looking: ‘When The Music’s Over…’
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Burry警告超大规模云厂商隐藏高达3万亿美元的AI负债，'音乐停下时'将引发系统性风险。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The same people that said, “We’ll all be dead in twelve years because of Global Warming,” a name since “reborn” to Climate Change, because the Planet was cooling, not warming, and nobody was dead, are the people that are now saying that AI is going to kill us, that robots are going to attack us, and everything is a DISASTER. This is more of a Hoax than even that of RUSSIA, RUSSIA, RUSSIA, UKRAINE, UKRAINE, UKRAINE, UKRAINE, and Climate Change! Whoever wins AI, WINS! We are leading now over China, and everyone else, and I’m going to keep it that way! I’m not going to stifle Growth, of something
items.summary_cn: 特朗普表示美国在AI领域领先中国，将保持增长不设限，反对以'AI威胁论'为由扼杀发展，利好整体AI板块。

items.author: 洪灏
items.text: Acer董事長：存儲缺貨已消失
items.summary_cn: 据报道，洪灏转述Acer董事长称存储缺货已消失，利空存储/DRAM板块。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Russia has unfortunately lost control of its Diesel Oil Industry due to its War with Ukraine. A large number of their Diesel refineries have been blown up and are, at least temporarily, out of commission. This ridiculous and never ending War with Ukraine must be ended. The whole World suffers as 25,000 people, mostly soldiers, are being killed each month. What a shame! President DJT
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称俄罗斯柴油炼厂遭打击产能受损，呼吁结束俄乌战争，能源供给面信息或影响油价。

items.author: Pelosi
items.text: Taiwan’s Status Is Ambiguous. U.S. Policy Shouldn’t Be.
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Pelosi发表评论称台湾地位模糊，美国政策不应模糊化，涉台海地缘风险。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The United States is working on a massive Deal with respect to the purchase of Potash from Belarus. The pricing would be for substantially less than we are currently paying to Canada, very good news for our Farmers and Ranchers. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普称美国正与白俄罗斯洽谈大规模钾肥(Potash)采购，价格低于从加拿大进口，利好美国农户。

items.author: Musk
items.text: US judge declines to block transfer of wildlife refuge land to Musk’s SpaceX
items.summary_cn: 据报道，美国法院驳回阻止将野生动物保护区土地转让给Musk旗下SpaceX的诉求。

items.author: Pelosi
items.text: Trump traded more securities than all Congress; backs stock-buying ban for all Congress lawmakers, but no
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Pelosi最新披露显示其证券交易活跃度高于其他国会议员，并支持全面禁止国会议员炒股。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Gas prices were much higher under Biden than under “TRUMP.” So were almost all other prices. President DJT
items.summary_cn: 特朗普重申其任内油价低于拜登时期，为常规政治表态。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk pitches hyperloop tunnel to cut Austin-San Antonio travel time
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk推介在德州奥斯汀-圣安东尼奥之间修建Hyperloop隧道概念。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Wants to Dig a Massive Tunnel in Texas to Connect These 2 Key Cities
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk想在德州挖一条连接两大城市的大型隧道。
